episodes.186087: Warming temperatures and areas of mixed rain and snow caused snowmelt flooding of streets across Anchorage.  Rainfall of 0.30 combined with the warming temperatures overran storm drains which were covered in ice and snow and unable to contain the runoff.
episodes.186230: A broad area of precipitation resulted in rain totals of 1-3 inches across the area. This resulted in some rises on smaller streams and waterways.
episodes.187030: Wind gusts of 50 to 60 mph were common along the Downeast coast and coastal waters. A maximum wind gust of 67 mph was measured at the Jonesport buoy. The high winds and rough seas caused 5 boats to break from their moorings in the Milbridge Harbor. Two of the boats were destroyed...with one of the boats sent crashing into a pier which was heavily damaged.

events.narrative: Street flooding at the intersection of Baxter Road at Northern Lights Blvd. Water was over 1 ft. deep with chunks of ice in the water.  Cars were impaired by flooding and snow covered roadways forcing cars to drive into the flooded area.
Neshanic gauge at Reaville went into minor flood stage.
